name: tag-input
description: Multi-value input composing the chip primitive and combobox listbox behaviour — type + Enter to add tags, Backspace to remove the last, dismiss buttons per tag, optional filtered suggestions, and a configurable duplicates policy

changes.note: Nested components keep their own parts. The stylesheet reached the tag list, input, listbox and options with descendant selectors, so a component nested inside with parts of the same name took this one's styles. Parts are root > taglist > input and root > listbox > option and empty. Every part rule is now a child chain from the root, with the hops in :where(), so no rule changes specificity. No change for markup that follows the template.

data-highlighted and data-hidden are now declared. The controller has always written both onto the options (active descendant and filtered-out respectively) and the CSS has always styled them, but no manifest named them. They are states rather than props because a controller writes them: a state is the runtime's vocabulary, a prop is what an author types. 0.8-10's undeclared-attribute rule now makes this class of drift impossible: an attribute a component's CSS selects on that its manifest never declares fails the registry gate.

taglist.description: The field box holding the committed tag chips and the text input

tag.description: A committed tag — a data-ui="chip" element (styled by chip.css) with a label and dismiss button; created and removed by the controller

input.description: The text input for typing new tags; role=combobox when a suggestions listbox is present

listbox.description: Optional suggestions dropdown with role=listbox (combobox listbox contract)

empty.description: Empty state shown when no suggestion matches the filter

value.description: Hidden input mirroring the tag array as JSON; the controller fires native input events on it so l-model stays in sync

highlighted.description: The active descendant of the suggestion listbox — the option arrow keys have moved to. The controller writes it; only one option carries it at a time

hidden.description: A suggestion filtered out by the current input, or already added as a tag. The controller writes it; hidden options are skipped by keyboard navigation

allowDuplicates.description: When data-allow-duplicates is present, repeated tags are permitted (default: rejected, case-insensitive)

required_attrs: role="group" on taglist with an accessible name
type="button" and aria-label on each chip dismiss button
role="combobox", aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded on the input when suggestions are present
role="listbox" on listbox, role="option" on each option, aria-controls linking input to listbox
aria-activedescendant on the combobox, naming the active option while the list is open

keyboard.Enter: commit the highlighted suggestion, else the trimmed draft, as a tag
keyboard.Backspace: on an empty input, remove the last tag
keyboard.ArrowDown/ArrowUp: highlight the next/previous suggestion (opening the listbox)

a11y.notes: The taglist is a role="group", not a role="list": the combobox input shares the box with the chips, and role="list" may only own role="listitem" children (axe aria-required-children). Each chip is reachable through its own labelled dismiss button, so no list semantics are lost. Tags reuse the chip primitive's dismiss button (a <button type="button"> with an aria-label). The suggestions listbox reuses the combobox listbox behaviour. The committed value is an array of strings, exposed via getValue(), the faqir:change event detail, and (serialized as JSON) the hidden [data-part="value"] input for l-model.
